summary: A Linear-enabled Product maps to one Linear team, each Concord Initiative to one Linear Project, and each repository Project to a team label; the project_ids repository mapping is removed. Optional entries carry an optional label, the first Initiative owns a shared entry, Linear Initiatives stay operator-owned, import reads a Linear Project, and each pull request carries a non-closing Related to reference with GitHub Issues Sync off.
title: Initiatives map to Linear Projects
